Entries.Original: HQ, do you copy? We've reached Nanohana View Terrace.
This is Tezuka from HQ. We've been waiting for you.
Commander, what do we do from here?
For now, remain in the area on standby.
Standby? Here? But why?
A helicopter should be arriving from the base in about ten minutes or so.
This was only possible because of your work in securing the surrounding area.
There will be a delivery of camping supplies via a parachute drop, so make sure to receive it.
With a parachute? Is it okay to be delivering supplies like that?
This is a common method of dropping supplies to the front lines.
There will be food, water, flashlights, tents, and other such supplies included.
You all haven't had proper training for camping in the field yet.
So be sure to follow Aoi's directions on how to use the supplies.
Woah, that's right. Camping's totally new to us.
Set up a shift schedule so everyone can eat, rest, and sleep in turns.
Really?! We can actually sleep?!
Temporarily. Think of it more as a brief nap.
A nap's good enough for me!
Knowing you, you're going to be completely out cold...
What exactly is a nap, anyway? I mean, people are either awake or asleep. So, is a nap kind of like being half-awake and half-asleep?
Don't describe it as if it were some abomination of nature...not like it matters. The whole point is that you need to be able to wake up on short notice.
Am I really capable of such a challenging feat?
If you can't, then you'd better start now. It's going to be an important skill for you as a soldier.
